Custom icons have the highest priority. They are mutually exclusive with preserving original icons; switching asks for confirmation. A choice applies to this app in every icon pack managed by KeiHome.

Each chosen icon is saved independently, including its available light, dark and dynamic resources. Source pack removal or cache cleanup does not remove your saved choice.
